exposure: Pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with systemic-to-pulmonary shunts
Pulmonary arterial hypertension with corrected congenital heart disease
cohort: The study included 93 pregnant women with PAH-CHD who were admitted for delivery in a tertiary center between February 2011 and September 2016.
finding: Maternal mortality and morbidity remain high in PAH-CHD patients.
